title: Finite stratified restrictions detect pro-etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Let $(i_\alpha:X_\alpha\to X)_\alpha$ be a finite stratification [def-constructible-stratification]. On each $X_\alpha$ choose a pro-etale covering $(v_{\alpha j}:V_{\alpha j}\to X_\alpha)_j$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For every abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, if $v_{\alpha j}^{-1}i_\alpha^{-1}F=0$ for all $\alpha,j$, then $F=0$, where inverse images are [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. In particular, for any ring sheaf $R$ on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$, the termwise exact inverse images to modules over its inverse images jointly detect zero objects and isomorphisms in $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Tag 09AH (lemma-ses-associated-to-open), and Tag 09AB (lemma-thickening), followed by Noetherian induction. The induction and covering detection are agent consequences, not the literal statements of those lemmas.

proof.text: Construct the comparison between module inverse image over an arbitrary (possibly noncommutative) ring sheaf and abelian inverse image. Transport the ring adjunction through the strict AsSmall site equivalences. Uniqueness of left adjoints compares the transported ring inverse image with the model-site ring pullback; the forgetful comparison and its unit equation give a SheafPullbackUnitPresentation for the actual ring unit. Apply SheafOfModules.inverseImage_underlying_of_ring_presentation to this presentation, then whisker with the strict module/site transports to obtain the natural underlying-abelian-sheaf comparison. All auxiliary constructions and comparisons are proved private helpers in the item module.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03D3; comparison respects the specified ring adjunction unit

proof.text: Abelian inverse image is additive by its adjunction to additive direct image, preserves finite limits by representable flatness of base change, and preserves colimits as a left adjoint. Module-to-abelian-sheaf forgetting is faithful, preserves finite limits and colimits, and reflects finite limits and colimits. Transfer additivity and both finite exactness properties across the comparison from step 1. This proves proEtaleRingModuleInverseImage_exact without a commutativity or flatness hypothesis on the coefficient ring.

source.place: Tags 04JC (first assertion) and 03DA; Mathlib finite-limit pullback and forgetful APIs

proof.text: For each stratum, identify composite inverse image with successive inverse images by ProEtale.upperStarComp. Its chosen pro-etale cover detects zero sheaves: identify inverse image along each covering map with localizationRestriction, and use ProEtale.isIso_of_isIso_localizationRestriction on the map from the restricted sheaf to zero. This accepts covering index universes of arbitrary size w and removes the chosen covering maps from the hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 09A5; localization and sheaf separatedness for base-changed pro-etale covers

proof.text: Equip X with its IsNoetherian structure. Each actual stratum immersion is a topological embedding, so its source has Noetherian underlying space and its immersion is quasi-compact. The finite immersion family is jointly surjective by the stratification union and range equations. Apply the already proved private declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.abDetectMaps from ProEtaleAbelianClosedSupport (import all), to the identity of the abelian sheaf. Each pulled-back identity is zero by step 3, and the generic finite quasi-compact joint detection lemma makes the original identity zero. This directly proves stratum detection, including an empty indexing family, without replacing any stratum by its reduction. It uses the generic declaration itself, not the closed-support theorem specialized outside its hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 09AH; the finite quasi-compact joint-detection argument already formalized as abDetectMaps in the closed-support module

proof.text: For a module sheaf, use the comparison of step 1 and faithful module forgetting to apply abelian detection to its underlying sheaf. For a derived object K, the exact-functor homology comparison identifies restriction of H^q(K) with H^q of each restriction for every integer q. If the restricted derived objects are zero, every restricted homology module is zero. Module detection makes every H^q(K) zero, and DerivedCategory.isZero_of_forall_isZero_homology makes K zero. No boundedness is used.

source.place: Tags 015F and 05RU; homology of exact termwise inverse image and homology detection in the ordinary unbounded localization

proof.text: Complete f:K→L to a distinguished triangle K→L→C→K[1]. Exact termwise restrictions are triangulated. For each chosen restriction, the zero-cone criterion Triangle.isZero₃_iff_isIso₁ makes the restricted C zero because the restricted f is invertible. The derived zero-detection part from step 5 makes C zero globally; apply the same zero-cone criterion to the original triangle to obtain IsIso f.

source.place: Tags 0145 and 0149; Mathlib distinguished cocone and zero-cone criterion
